notes: An immortal with no clan-number argument receives C's invalid-clan response.
Zero and out-of-range immortal clan numbers use the exact C invalid-clan response.
A valid immortal clan number with no message receives the C clan-message prompt.
A rank prefix containing non-digits receives the C numeric-rank refusal.
A rank threshold above the clan rank count receives the C no-hearer refusal.
A rank-two threshold reaches the same-clan rank-two member; the second clan makes the C rank-count lookup reachable.
A normal immortal clan tell emits the C sender line and same-clan recipient line.
PRF_NOREPEAT replaces the sender echo with C's Okay. while recipients still receive the tell.
